lead_editorial.title: Toofan guzar gaya, ab asli imtihaan — Arnab ke maare kisaanon tak madad tez aur bina kaagazi uljhan ke pahunche
lead_editorial.summary: Cyclone Arnab kamzor hokar depression ban gaya hai, lekin Andhra Pradesh mein shuruaati anumaan ke mutabik 80,000 hectare se zyada fasal barbaad hui hai. Rahat ki asli kasauti ab nuksaan ka sahi aaklan aur tez bharpai hogi.
body: India Meteorological Department ke mutabik Cyclone Arnab Guruvaar dopahar tak kamzor hokar depression ban gaya aur south Chhattisgarh aur us se lage south Odisha ke upar uttar ki taraf badh raha tha. Lekin toofan ka kamzor padna kahani ka ant nahi hai. News On AIR ki report ke mutabik Andhra Pradesh mein shuruaati anumaan 70,000 hectare se zyada dhaan aur 10,000 hectare se zyada baagwaani faslon ke nuksaan ka hai — yani kharif ki kataai se theek pehle hazaaron parivaaron ki saal bhar ki kamaai daanv par hai.

Rajya sarkar ki shuruaati pratikriya sahi disha mein dikhti hai. Mukhyamantri N. Chandrababu Naidu ne mritakon ke parivaaron ke liye Rs 5 lakh ki ex-gratia ka elaan kiya hai, 28,000 se zyada logon ko relief shelters mein pahunchaya gaya aur Visakhapatnam mein lagbhag 80% bijli bahaal hone ki report hai. Naidu ne Centre se jaldi aaklan ke liye inter-ministerial team bhejne ki maang bhi ki hai. Odisha mein Bahuda nadi ka jalastar badhne se East Coast Railway ko nau trainein radd karni padi — yaani asar sirf ek rajya tak simit nahi.

Hamari raay mein ab sabse zaroori hai ki nuksaan ka survey teen cheezon par khara utre: raftaar, paardarshita aur bataidaar kisaanon ki pehchaan. Aksar dekha gaya hai ki zameen ka maalik kaagazon mein hota hai aur kheti koi aur karta hai; aise mein bharpai sahi haath tak nahi pahunchti. Gaon-star par survey ki suchi saarvajanik karna aur shikaayat ke liye seedha raasta dena is kami ko kaafi had tak door kar sakta hai. Fasal beema ke daavon ka nipataara bhi mahino tak latakna nahi chahiye.

Kendra ki team jitni jaldi aayegi, rahat ka paisa utni jaldi khulega. Pichhle toofanon ne dikhaya hai ki jaan bachaane mein India ki taiyari kaafi behtar hui hai — ab yahi kushalta toofan ke baad ki bahaali mein bhi dikhni chahiye. Kisaan ke liye asli rahat elaan se nahi, khaate mein samay par aaye paise se hoti hai.

stories.title: Dual PAN card case: Allahabad HC ne Azam Khan aur bete Abdullah ko di zamaanat, sazaa suspend — par conviction par rok nahi, chunav ladne par pabandi barkaraar
stories.summary: Justice Samit Gopal ki single bench ne Guruvaar ko dono ki sazaa suspend kar zamaanat di, lekin conviction par stay ki maang thukra di. Reports ke mutabik isse 2027 ke UP chunav mein dono ki ummeedvaari par rok bani rahegi.
body: Samajwadi Party ke varishth neta Azam Khan aur unke bete Abdullah Azam Khan ko Guruvaar, 29 October ko Allahabad High Court se badi raahat mili. The News Mill ki report ke mutabik Justice Samit Gopal ki single-judge bench ne dual PAN card maamle mein dono ko zamaanat de di aur trial court ki sunaayi sazaa ko suspend kar diya. Court ne dono pakshon ki dalilein sunne ke baad 15 October ko faisla surakshit rakha tha.

Lekin court ne conviction par stay lagaane ki maang thukra di. The Daily Jagran ki report ke mutabik November 2025 mein Rampur ki special MP/MLA court ne dono ko dhokhadhadi, jaalsaazi aur aapraadhik saazish ki dharaon mein doshi tehraaya tha aur Azam Khan ko 10 saal tatha Abdullah ko 7 saal ki sazaa sunaayi thi. Report ke mutabik Representation of the People Act ke tahat do saal ya usse zyada ki sazaa waala conviction chunav ladne se rokta hai, isliye conviction barkaraar rehne se dono 2027 ke UP Vidhan Sabha chunav nahi lad paayenge, jab tak koi oonchi adaalat conviction par rok na lagaaye.

Maamla 2019 mein BJP neta Akash Saxena ki shikaayat se shuru hua tha, jismein aarop hai ki Abdullah Azam ne alag-alag janm-tithi waale do PAN card banwaaye aur istemaal kiye. Ek alag maamle mein, reports ke mutabik Enforcement Directorate ne 28 October ko money laundering jaanch ke tahat Azam Khan ki Mohammad Ali Jauhar University ki zameen aur imaaraton ko attach kiya hai; is par Azam Khan paksh ki pratikriya reports mein nahi hai.

stories.title: PM Modi kal se do din Gujarat mein: Banaskantha se PM-KISAN ki 24vi kist, Rs 14,000 crore se zyada ki pariyojnaayein; 31 October ko Ekta Nagar mein Rashtriya Ekta Diwas
stories.summary: PTI ke mutabik PM 30 October ko Banaskantha mein pariyojnaon ka udghaatan karenge aur kisaanon ke khaaton mein kist bhejenge. 31 October ko Sardar Patel ki 151vi jayanti par Statue of Unity par karyakram hoga.
body: ThePrint par chhapi PTI ki report ke mutabik Pradhanmantri Narendra Modi 30-31 October ko Gujarat ke daure par rahenge. Pehle din Banaskantha mein woh Rs 14,000 crore se zyada ki pariyojnaon ka shilanyas aur udghaatan karenge, Embryo Transfer Technology-IVF Laboratory aur Bharat Bovine Breeding and Research Centre ka daura karenge, do trainon ko hari jhandi dikhayenge aur PM-KISAN ki 24vi kist jaari karenge. Business Standard ke mutabik yeh kist Rs 18,680 crore se zyada ki hogi, jabki PTI ne ise Rs 19,000 crore bataaya hai; national karyakram Banaskantha ke Bhildi mein hoga.

Ghoshit pariyojnaon mein Ahmedabad Metro ke Phase 2A (Koteshwar Road se Airport) aur Phase 2B (GIFT City se Shahpur) ka shilanyas, Ahmedabad-Mehsana road ko chaar se aath lane karne ka lagbhag Rs 2,600 crore ka kaam, aur 4,030 naye Anganwadi kendron ki neev shaamil hai. Agriculture Infrastructure Fund ke tahat bane 521 project bhi samarpit kiye jaayenge.

31 October ko PM Ekta Nagar mein Statue of Unity par shraddhanjali denge aur Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel ki 151vi jayanti par Rashtriya Ekta Diwas ke karyakram mein hissa lenge. Woh 15 November tak chalne waale saanskritik utsav Bharat Parv 2026 ka udghaatan bhi karenge. Isse ek din pehle, 28 October ko PM ne 54vi PRAGATI baithak mein 31 rajyon aur UTs ki Rs 16,000 crore se zyada ki pariyojnaon ki samiksha ki thi.

stories.title: Cyclone Arnab kamzor hokar depression bana; Andhra mein 80,000 hectare se zyada fasal barbaad hone ka shuruaati anumaan, CM Naidu ne Rs 5 lakh ex-gratia ka elaan kiya
stories.summary: IMD ke mutabik system shaam tak aur kamzor hokar low pressure area ban jaayega. Odisha mein Bahuda nadi ke badhte jalastar ke kaaran nau trainein radd aur 14 ka raasta badla gaya.
body: News On AIR ki Guruvaar dopahar ki report ke mutabik Cyclone Arnab deep depression se kamzor hokar depression ban gaya aur south Chhattisgarh tatha south Odisha ke upar uttar ki taraf badh raha tha. IMD ka anumaan hai ki shaam tak yeh north Chhattisgarh aur northwest Odisha ke upar well-marked low pressure area mein badal jaayega. Pichhle 24 ghanton mein north Andhra Pradesh, northeast Telangana, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, Jharkhand aur Gangetic West Bengal mein vyaapak baarish hui.

Andhra Pradesh mein nuksaan ka shuruaati aaklan saamne aaya hai. News On AIR ke mutabik 70,000 hectare se zyada dhaan aur 10,000 hectare se zyada baagwaani faslein prabhavit hui hain. Mukhyamantri N. Chandrababu Naidu ne mritakon ke parivaaron ko Rs 5 lakh ex-gratia dene ka elaan kiya aur Centre se nuksaan ke aaklan ke liye inter-ministerial team bhejne ki maang ki. 28,000 se zyada log relief shelters mein hain; Visakhapatnam mein lagbhag 80% bijli bahaal ho chuki hai, jabki Konaseema, Kakinada aur Godavari zilon mein marammat jaari hai. Report mein maut ka kul aankda nahi diya gaya.
Odisha mein UNI ke mutabik Bahuda nadi ka jalastar badhne ke kaaran East Coast Railway ne nau trainein radd kar di aur 14 trainon ka raasta badla.

image.alt: Andhra Pradesh ke Mukhyamantri N. Chandrababu Naidu ka portrait (file photo)

editorial.title: Zamaanat raahat hai, bari hona nahi — Azam Khan faisle ko siyaasi jeet-haar ke chashme se dekhna galat hoga
body: Allahabad High Court ka faisla do baaton ko alag rakhta hai: sazaa ka suspend hona aur conviction ka bana rehna. Appeal lambit rehne tak zamaanat dena aam nyaayik prakriya hai; iska matlab yeh nahi ki adaalat ne aaropon ko khaarij kar diya. Conviction par stay se inkaar ka seedha asar chunavi yogyata par padta hai, aur yahi is faisle ka sabse ahem hissa hai.

Hamari raay mein siyaasi dalon ko is faisle ko na 'nyaay ki jeet' bataana chahiye na 'badle ki rajneeti' ka saboot. Maamla ab appeal ki prakriya mein hai aur antim faisla wahin hoga. Saath hi, jan-pratinidhiyon se jude mukadmon ka saalon tak khinchna khud ek samasya hai — MP/MLA courts ka maqsad tez sunwaai tha, aur appeal star par bhi wahi raftaar dikhni chahiye taaki na kisi nirdosh ka career bewajah ruke, na kisi doshi ko lambi prakriya ka fayda mile.

stories.title: Brazil: chunav haarne ke baad Flávio Bolsonaro Supreme Court ke passport aadesh ke bawajood desh chhodkar Miami pahunche; dhaandhli ke daave, saboot nahi
stories.summary: Al Jazeera ke mutabik Bolsonaro parivaar paidal Argentina pahuncha aur wahan se private plane se Ecuador hote hue Miami gaya. US State Department ne parivaar ko visa diye; Trump ne unhe 'fine people' kaha.
body: Brazil ke raashtrapati chunav mein Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva se haarne waale Flávio Bolsonaro Budhvaar ko Miami pahunch gaye. Al Jazeera ki report ke mutabik Brazil ke Supreme Court ne chunav ke turant baad unhe apne saamaanya aur diplomatic passport jama karne ka aadesh diya tha, taaki embezzlement aur money laundering ki jaanch se pehle woh desh na chhod sakein. Senator ke taur par unhe immunity mili hui thi, lekin president ka chunav ladne ke liye seat chhodne ke baad January mein yeh suraksha khatm ho jaayegi.

Report ke mutabik Bolsonaro aur unka parivaar Mangalvaar der raat ek pul par paidal chalkar Argentina pahuncha, wahan se private plane se Guayaquil (Ecuador) gaya aur phir Budhvaar subah Miami ke paas Opa-Locka Executive Airport par utra. US State Department ne parivaar ko visa jaari kiye aur President Trump ne Bolsonaro parivaar ko 'fine people' kaha.

10 Things Global News ke mutabik Flávio Bolsonaro bina koi saboot diye chunav mein dhaandhli ka daava kar rahe hain, jabki Brazil ke chunav adhikariyon ne natije ko kaanooni roop se sahi bataaya hai; Lula lagbhag 44 lakh vote se jeete. Lula ne US par dakhalandaazi ka aarop lagaaya hai. Bolsonaro ke pita Jair Bolsonaro bhi 2022 ki haar ke baad Florida gaye the; woh abhi house arrest mein hain.

image.alt: Brazil ke senator ke roop mein Flávio Bolsonaro (file photo)

stories.title: Yemen: Houthi missile hamle ke baad Aden International Airport par udaanein ruki; naagrik ghayal, October mein doosra bada hamla
stories.summary: Yemen ke sena pravakta ke mutabik do ballistic missile airport par gire. Houthis ne hamle se pehle airport khaali karne ki chetavni di thi.
body: Gulf News ki report ke mutabik Yemen ki Saudi-samarthit sarkar ne bataaya ki Budhvaar, 28 October ko Houthi vidrohiyon ne Aden International Airport par hamla kiya. Yemen ke sena pravakta aur Transport Ministry ke mutabik do ballistic missile airport par lage, jisse naagrik ghayal hue aur sampatti ko nuksaan pahuncha; Reuters ke hawaale se report mein kaha gaya ki iske baad hawaai yaatayaat rok diya gaya. Ghayalon ki sankhya nahi bataayi gayi.

Houthis ne hamle se pehle airport khaali karne ki chetavni di thi. 10 Things Global News ke mutabik Houthi pravakta Yahya Saree ne daava kiya ki hamla wahan Saudi sainya cargo vimaan ki maujoodgi ke kaaran kiya gaya; Saudi adhikariyon ne is daave par pratikriya nahi di. Isse pehle 7 October ko bhi airport par missile aur drone se hamla hua tha.

Aden airport dakshin Yemen ke liye ahem pravesh dwaar hai aur maanviya sahaayata, dawaiyon aur sahaayata karmiyon ki aawajahi isi se hoti hai. Yemen ki Transport Ministry ne baar-baar ke hamlon ki ninda karte hue kaha ki isse naagrikon aur hawaai suraksha ko khatra hai.

stories.title: IAEA chief Grossi ne UN Security Council se kaha — Iran ki hamle mein tooti nuclear sites ki marammat ka koi sanket nahi; par 440 kg 60% enriched uranium ka haal ab bhi agyaat
stories.summary: Grossi ne Iran se sabhi sites par inspectors ko pahunch dene ki apeel ki. Russia aur China ne baithak rokne ki koshish ki, jo naakaam rahi.
body: AP ki report (Free Press Journal par prakaashit) ke mutabik International Atomic Energy Agency ke Director General Rafael Grossi ne Mangalvaar ko UN Security Council ko bataaya ki agency ko aisa koi sanket nahi mila hai ki Iran ne 2025 aur 2026 ke US-Israeli hamlon mein kshatigrast nuclear thikaanon ko dobara banane ki koshish ki ho. Unke shabdon mein, marammat ya punarnirmaan ki 'koi gatividhi' nahi dikhi.

Lekin IAEA ke mutabik Iran ke paas 60% tak enriched 440.9 kg uranium hai — jo hathiyaar-star (90%) se ek chhota takneeki kadam door maana jaata hai — aur June 2025 ke hamlon ke baad se agency is bhandaar ki sthiti verify nahi kar paayi hai. Grossi ne Iran se sabhi sites, khaaskar kshatigrast thikaanon, par inspectors ko pahunch dene ki apeel ki. Iran apne karyakram ko shaantipurn bataata hai.

Yeh baithak Bahrain, Denmark, Latvia, France, UK aur US ne IAEA dwara Iran ko Security Council ke paas bheje jaane ke baad bulaayi thi; Russia aur China ne ise rokne ki naakaam koshish ki. Report ke mutabik US Ambassador Mike Waltz aur Iran ke up-rajdoot Gholamhossein Darzi ke beech tikhi bahas hui.

image.alt: IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi ek mulaqat ke dauraan (file photo)

editorial.title: Haar maanna bhi loktantra ka hissa hai — Brazil se nikalkar dhaandhli ke bebuniyaad daave karna khatarnaak misaal hai
body: Chunav mein haar-jeet loktantra ka saamaanya hissa hai, lekin court ke aadesh ko darkinaar kar desh chhodna aur bina saboot dhaandhli ke daave karna sansthaon par bharose ko kamzor karta hai. Brazil ke chunav adhikariyon ne natije ko kaanooni bataaya hai; agar Flávio Bolsonaro ke paas sachmuch koi saboot hai, to uski jagah adaalat hai, Miami ka airport nahi.

Hamari raay mein US ka seedhe visa dena aur Trump ki taareef is maamle ko do deshon ke rishton ka mudda bhi bana deti hai. India jaise loktantron ke liye sabak saaf hai: chunav aayog aur adaalaton ki saakh har party ki saajha poonji hai, aur use kamzor karne ki keemat aakhir mein poore desh ko chukaani padti hai.

stories.title: Fed ke faisle ke baad bazaar mein raunak: Sensex 905 ank uchhalkar 74,151 par, Nifty 22,936 par band; Kotak Bank 4% se zyada chadha
stories.summary: Realty, FMCG aur PSU Bank indices mein tezi rahi, sirf Auto index laal nishaan mein. Kotak Neo ke mutabik FII khareed, LTCG tax mein raahat ki ummeed aur kachche tel mein narmi ne sahaara diya.
body: Guruvaar ko Sensex 905.01 ank (1.24%) chadhkar 74,151.04 par aur Nifty 50 237.90 ank (1.05%) chadhkar 22,936.75 par band hua. 5paisa ke post-market update ke mutabik Nifty Realty 2.75% aur Nifty FMCG 2.34% chadhe, jabki Nifty Auto 0.24% girkar akela girne waala sectoral index raha. Midcap aur smallcap indices lagbhag 1% chadhe; 2,196 shares badhe aur 1,387 gire.

Nifty ki tezi mein sabse bada yogdaan Kotak Mahindra Bank (4.32% upar), Adani Ports aur Eternal ka raha, jabki HDFC Bank, Maruti Suzuki aur Trent ne index ko neeche kheencha. Kotak Neo ke mutabik US Federal Reserve ka byaaj daron ko sthir rakhna, long-term capital gains tax mein katauti ki badhti ummeed, FIIs ki khareed aur West Asia mein diplomacy ki charcha se kachche tel ki keemat mein narmi ne bazaar ko sahaara diya. Report ke mutabik SEBI chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey ne FPIs ke compliance niyamon ki samiksha ki baat bhi kahi.

Brent ke daam alag-alag reports mein $110 se $114 prati barrel ke daayre mein bataaye gaye; 5paisa ne aagaah kiya ki ooncha tel India ke liye mehngaai aur import bill ka jokhim bana hua hai. (Yeh nivesh salaah nahi hai.)

image.alt: Mumbai mein Bombay Stock Exchange ki imaarat (file photo)

stories.title: Ather Energy ka market cap Rs 65,000 crore pahuncha, Ola Electric se 3.5 guna; ek hafte mein share lagbhag 20% chadha
stories.summary: UNI ki report ke mutabik Ather ke net profit report karne ke baad shares mein tezi aayi. Dono electric two-wheeler companiyon ke beech nivesh dharna ka antar badhta dikh raha hai.
body: UNI ki report ke mutabik electric two-wheeler kampani Ather Energy ka market capitalisation is hafte lagbhag Rs 65,000 crore tak pahunch gaya, jo pratidwandi Ola Electric ke market cap ka lagbhag 3.5 guna hai. Report ke mutabik pichhle ek hafte mein Ather ke share lagbhag 20% chadhe, aur yeh tezi kampani ke net profit report karne ke baad aayi.

UNI ne is antar ke peechhe nivesh dharna, vittiya pradarshan aur bikri ke rujhaan mein badhte fark ko kaaran bataaya hai. Report ke uplabdh hisse mein profit ki rakam aur dono kampaniyon ke share ke daam ka byora nahi diya gaya. (Yeh nivesh salaah nahi hai.)

editorial.title: Ek din ki 905 ank ki chhalaang achhi hai, par $110 se upar ka tel abhi bhi sabse bada sawaal hai
body: Guruvaar ki tezi ne dikhaya ki niveshak West Asia mein diplomacy ki chhoti si ummeed par bhi tezi se pratikriya dete hain. Fed ka sthir rehna aur FIIs ki khareed sakaaraatmak sanket hain. Lekin Brent abhi bhi $110 ke upar hai, aur India jaise bade tel aayaatak ke liye yeh mehngaai aur chaalu khaata ghaate par seedha dabaav hai.

Hamari raay mein LTCG tax mein raahat jaisi ummeedon par bani tezi tab tak tikau nahi maani ja sakti jab tak sarkar khud koi ghoshna na kare. Choti bachat karne waale niveshakon ke liye behtar yahi hai ki ek din ki chaal dekhkar faisle na lein — yeh salaah nahi, saavdhaani ki baat hai.

stories.title: Kal Eden Park mein India-New Zealand chautha T20I; 3-0 se series jeet chuki Team India ki nazar clean sweep par, Abhishek Sharma bane ICC T20I ranking mein No. 1
stories.summary: Teesre T20I mein Abhishek ke 38 gend mein 113 ranon ne India ko 6 wicket se jeet dilaayi. Ab woh Ishan Kishan ko peechhe chhodkar duniya ke number ek T20I ballebaaz hain.
body: News On AIR ke mutabik India aur New Zealand ke beech paanch match ki T20I series ka chautha mukabla Shukravaar, 30 October ko Auckland ke Eden Park mein Bhartiya samay dopahar 12:30 baje shuru hoga. India pehle teeno match jeetkar series apne naam kar chuka hai; paanchva aur aakhri match Ravivaar ko hoga.

Teesre T20I (27 October, Wellington) mein Outlook India ki report ke mutabik New Zealand ne Daryl Mitchell ke career-best 89 naabad ki madad se 198/3 banaaye the, jiske jawaab mein India ne 40 gend baaki rehte 6 wicket se jeet hasil ki. Abhishek Sharma ne sirf 38 gend mein 113 ran banaaye — News On AIR ke mutabik yeh unka chautha T20I shatak tha.

Is pari ke dum par Abhishek ICC Men's T20I batting rankings mein Ishan Kishan ko hataakar pehle sthaan par pahunch gaye hain. Pakistan ke Sahibzada Farhan doosre aur Kishan teesre sthaan par khisak gaye. Test all-rounders ki ranking mein South Africa ke Marco Jansen ne Ravindra Jadeja ki jagah top sthaan liya.

stories.title: 'Jailer 2' ne Kerala mein Rs 72.85 crore gross ke saath tod diya 'Baahubali 2' ka nau saal purana record
stories.summary: Sacnilk ke mutabik Rajinikanth ki film 13 din mein Kerala mein sabse zyada kamaane waali gair-Malayalam film ban gayi.
body: Box office tracking site Sacnilk ki report ke mutabik Rajinikanth ki 'Jailer 2' ne Kerala mein 13 din mein Rs 72.85 crore ka gross collection kar liya hai. Isse film ne 2017 ki 'Baahubali 2' ka lagbhag Rs 72.25 crore ka lifetime Kerala record tod diya, jo nau saal se kaayam tha, aur yeh rajya mein sabse zyada kamaai karne waali gair-Malayalam film ban gayi.

Sacnilk ke anya aankdon ke mutabik film ka India net collection 14 din mein Rs 423 crore tak pahuncha hai. Udhar Ranbir Kapoor ki 'Ramayana' 5 November ko release hone waali hai aur trade mein uske overseas opening ko lekar charcha tez hai.

image.alt: Dadasaheb Phalke Award samaaroh mein Rajinikanth (file photo)

stories.title: Putin ne Elon Musk ko 'genius' bataaya, kaha — satellites ko lekar Russia unke 'kareebi sampark' mein; Ukraine mein Starlink rukawat ke baad aaya bayaan
stories.summary: Russia-Africa summit ke dauraan Putin ne kaha ki orbit mein ek-doosre ke kaam mein dakhal na ho, isliye sampark zaroori hai. Russia Starlink ke jawaab mein apna Rassvet network bana raha hai.
body: Meduza ki report ke mutabik Russia-Africa summit ke saath lagi ek pradarshani ke dauraan Russian President Vladimir Putin ne SpaceX ke sansthaapak Elon Musk ko Starlink banaane ke liye 'genius' kaha. Putin ne kaha ki raajnaitik matbhedon ke bawajood Russia Musk samet US saajhedaaron ke sampark mein hai, taaki orbit mein ek-doosre ke kaam mein rukawat na ho. Is dauraan unhe Russia ke Starlink-jaise Rassvet constellation ka ek satellite dikhaaya gaya.

10 Things Global News ke mutabik yeh bayaan us samay aaya jab Ukraine ko lagbhag do hafte tak Starlink aur Starshield seva mein rukawat jhelni padi, jisse uske drone aur air defence operations par asar pada; baad mein President Zelenskyy ne seva bahaal hone ki pushti ki. Meduza ke mutabik Musk ne kaha tha ki yeh pabandiyaan is chinta se lagi thi ki Russia SpaceX ke satellites ko maar gira sakta hai. Report ke mutabik Rassvet network SpaceX ke lagbhag 10,000 satellites ke muqaable kaafi chhota hai.

editorial.title: Abhishek ka No. 1 banna jashn ki baat hai — ab chunauti is aakramak andaaz ko lagaataar nibhaane ki hai
body: 38 gend mein 113 ran aur 199 ka lakshya 40 gend pehle haasil karna dikhaata hai ki Bhartiya T20 ballebaazi ab kis raftaar se khel rahi hai. Abhishek Sharma ka Ishan Kishan ko peechhe chhodkar top par pahunchna yeh bhi bataata hai ki team ke andar hi pratispardha kitni tez hai — aur yahi kisi bhi team ki gehraai ka asli saboot hai.

Hamari raay mein series pehle hi jeet lene ke baad bache do match naye khiladiyon ko aazmaane ka sahi mauka hain. Clean sweep achha lagega, par agle bade toornaament ke liye bench ki taaqat parakhna usse zyada keemti ho sakta hai.
